decision.reason: Live Stripe, install-site, and manual-grant records remain ambiguous. No completed sale is confirmed by the bounded evidence, but absence of a confirmed sale is not zero-sales proof. Preserve every ambiguous record and customer right.

rails.basis: Offer-marked order items are recorded as test-mode manual orders; no transaction, activation, subscription, refund, or chargeback proves a genuine approved sale.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: None for the bounded EDD snapshot; preserve rows and re-read fully paginated EDD customers, orders, items, transactions, licenses, activations, subscriptions, refund order types, and chargebacks immediately before any future cutover decision.

rails.basis: The bounded snapshot contains no Focusa/UIAI/Bundle semantic marker and no payment/feed record.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: None for the bounded Gravity Forms snapshot; immediately before any future cutover, re-read all paginated entries and metadata plus Stripe feed configuration, callbacks, and payment transactions and recompute the semantic digest.

rails.basis: Test-account matches are synthetic. Nine live-mode incomplete or expired objects do not prove payment, but their relationship to historical offer claims is unresolved.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: For each of the nine redacted live-mode matches, read the Stripe Customer, Checkout Session, PaymentIntent, Charge, Refund, and Dispute linkage, metadata, amount/currency, livemode, payment and refund status, and created timestamp; correlate by immutable Stripe IDs to the install-site webhook/audit record and classify genuine, synthetic, or unrelated without storing identity fields.

rails.basis: Fifty-five offer records lack sufficient synthetic or customer-purchase semantics; status and webhook counts alone cannot establish safe discard or genuine approval.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: For each of the 55 redacted ambiguous records, read source, product, status, creation/refund/revoke audit chain, immutable Stripe object references, webhook event type and livemode, and payment/refund outcome; join those references to the Stripe rail and emit only class counts plus a recomputed digest.

rails.basis: One API grant has synthetic semantics and 26 do not. These overlap EDD and install-site records and cannot be treated as no-sale evidence.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: For each of the 26 redacted ambiguous grants, read issuer/source, creation reason, operator audit reference, linked EDD order/item/transaction and Stripe object IDs, product, status, and revoke/refund chain; classify only after immutable-ID correlation and emit no key or identity value.

rails.basis: Synthetic/test evidence is classified separately and never contributes to a genuine-sales count.
rails.next_read_only_evidence_needed: Recompute this separate class from immutable test-mode and explicit synthetic markers after resolving overlaps; never infer synthetic status merely from missing payment evidence.
